page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfg6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.8 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed environments. Because the CPU allocation is dedicated, workloads benefit from consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants. The high clock speed of 3.1 GHz on the Intel Xeon processor supports single-threaded performance efficiency alongside its massive multi-threaded capacity.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.ebmhfg6.20xlarge offers a balanced ratio of compute power to memory, aligning it with high-density general-purpose and compute-intensive workloads. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces overhead for deployments that rely strictly on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing. This profile is suitable for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, and database hosting.
